meta_description:
3,723 likes, 68 comments - arihantbaidofficial on September 28, 2026: "India’s real architectural marvel is made in white marble and its not Taj Mahal

We have heard a lot about Taj Mahal but very few people know about this real architectural beauty of India. 

This white marble structure built in the backdrop of the desert looks like the shining moon in the dark night. The views of the city and the most prominent fort of India from here are hard to describe. 

You will have to experience it for yourself. Next time someone says that the Indians were taught architecture by Mughals or British, do send them this video. 

This is Jaswant Thada, a memorial built for Jaswant Singh ji, the ruler of Marwar region in the city of Jodhpur, Rajasthan. If we don’t show the beauty of our country, who else will? 

So share this video with your travel partner and plan a trip here soon. 

Follow my page because I only show you such beautiful places.".
